summary: Frontend-only validation of 5 new features on TipJar members / Hall-of-Fame area. All 5 flows PASS end-to-end against preview URL as admin. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors observed.
verified_flows: PUBLIC PROFILE (from tip card): In tips-window > tabview-members, clicking [data-testid='gift-user-btn-seed-community-pending'] opens [data-testid='public-profile-modal'] with inner [data-testid='public-profile']. Header shows [data-testid='profile-username']='@TipJarHQ', 'Member since Jul 2026' line renders (i18n key profile.memberSince — 'Mitglied seit' equivalent, currently rendered in EN locale), exactly 3 stat tiles (12 Tips / 0 Wins / 0 Received), and 'Gift credits' button [data-testid='profile-gift-btn'] visible.

PROFILE -> GIFT: As admin, clicking profile-gift-btn on TipJarHQ profile closes the public-profile-modal (visibility=false) and opens [data-testid='wallet-modal'] with the Gift tab active ([data-testid='gift-panel'] present) and [data-testid='gift-to'] input pre-filled value = 'TipJarHQ'. Self-gift guard (username === user.username) confirmed in App.js openGiftTo.

PER-LEG ODDS: Seeded 'Community' parlay (seed-community-pending) by @TipJarHQ shows 5 per-leg odds chips: '@1.20', '@1.22', '@1.24', '@2.10', '@1.30' — rendered as font-mono font-bold text-volt spans next to each selection. Handicap labels present ('Sutjeska Nikšić Handicap +3.5', 'Connah's Quay Nomads Handicap +2.5', 'Petrocub Handicap -1.5'). Gesamtquote 6.42 shown.

SHARE BUTTON: The pending community parlay shows [data-testid='share-tip-seed-community-pending'] with label 'Share'. In headless Chromium navigator.share and navigator.canShare are BOTH undefined (verified), so the fallback path runs: window.open was called exactly once with URL 'https://t.me/share/url?url=<share-image>&text=…https%3A%2F%2Ftipjarglobal.com'. The Telegram share text includes the TipJar website URL (https://tipjarglobal.com) as required. Button is not stuck disabled after click. POST /api/tips/{id}/share-image succeeded (share URL contains /api/files/tipjar/shares/seed-community-pending.webp).
TEILEN GATING: 0 share buttons rendered in tabview-ai and tabview-smart views (as required — hq-auto and smart sources excluded). Only the member pending parlay shows the button.

HOF viewer -> PUBLIC PROFILE: [data-testid='hof-img-0'] renders; opening via [data-testid='hof-open-0'] shows [data-testid='hof-viewer']; clicking [data-testid='hof-viewer-user'] (label '@TipJarAdmin') opens [data-testid='public-profile-modal'] (NOT the wallet directly) showing profile-username='@TipJarAdmin' with stats 0 Tips / 1 Wins / 3 Received. Wallet modal is NOT visible.
No console errors and no page errors across the entire flow (login → members → profile → gift → share → HOF → viewer → profile).
critical_code_review_comments: PublicProfileModal.jsx uses the i18n key profile.memberSince — verify translations exist for all locales (en/de/es/fr/it/tr/ar/el). Screenshot showed 'Member since Jul 2026' in the current EN session; the German rendering ('Mitglied seit …') should be validated once by switching locale.

shareSlip.js: nice fallback ordering (canShare(files) → share(text,url) → t.me/share). AbortError swallowed silently — good for user-cancel. Consider surfacing a toast when the fallback popup is blocked by browser (some strict popup blockers may drop the window.open).
RateWall TipCard doShare has proper try/finally that always clears sharing state; button not left in disabled state after any failure. Confirmed empirically.
App.js openGiftTo self-gift guard is silent (return early). This is consistent with prev iteration 27 review comment — a small toast 'You cannot gift yourself' would improve UX but is not a blocker.

openProfile has no self-guard, so a user viewing their own HOF slip can open their own PublicProfileModal and see the Gift button — clicking it will silently no-op via openGiftTo self-guard. Consider hiding profile-gift-btn when username === user.username to avoid the confusing dead-click.
